name: Suzuhara Sora
source:
Distant and reserved, Sora Suzuhara is a second-year student who is also on the swim team. With a preference for solitude and disinterest in others, Sora is antisocial, nihilistic, mysterious, and deadpan. Through her acquaintance with [url=/c1831]Yoshijirou[/url] however, Sora becomes emotional, open and appreciative.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maple_Colors]Wikipedia[/url].]
